title: Strictly Semistable Quasimaps on the Wall
summary: Moduli spaces of $ε$-stable quasimaps exhibit a wall and chamber structure, interpolating between the moduli of stable quasimaps and Kontsevich's moduli spaces of stable maps. In the case where the target is projective space, we develop an intrinsic framework for the wall crossing phenomenon by constructing an algebraic stack where strictly semistable objects appear at a wall in the space of $ε$-stability conditions.
